changesRequestedReviews.author: reviewer
changesRequestedReviews.body: High-level design issue — please discuss in a follow-up PR.

instructions: Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to a one-line outcome; run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_inline1 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
